criteria.evidence: No test asserts that a paragraph with the text "Changed: Cycle time improved by 2 days" exists in the health section. The only test, "the health summary is the first section", asserts that the first paragraph in #health reads "Status: All clear" — it never references the "Changed:" paragraph at all. A passing suite here proves nothing about this criterion.

criteria.criterion: Given the report page, When it is opened, Then that paragraph comes after the `Status: All clear` paragraph, inside the health section, and before the Current Sprint section
criteria.evidence: No test asserts the positional ordering of the "Changed:" paragraph relative to the "Status: All clear" paragraph, its containment within the health section, or its position before the Current Sprint section. The test "the health summary is the first section" only checks that #health is the first section under main and that its first paragraph says "Status: All clear". It does not verify any ordering constraint involving the "Changed:" paragraph.

criteria.criterion:
Given the report page
When it is opened
Then the health section contains a paragraph reading exactly `Changed: Cycle time improved by 2 days`
criteria.evidence: Test `"the health section shows what changed since the prior sprint"` (tests/page.spec.js:10) locates `#health p` filtered by the exact text, asserts count is 1, and asserts `toHaveText("Changed: Cycle time improved by 2 days")` which checks exact match. This directly exercises the criterion.

criteria.criterion:
Given the report page
When it is opened
Then that paragraph comes after the `Status: All clear` paragraph, inside the health section, and before the Current Sprint section
criteria.evidence: Test `"the changed paragraph is ordered after status and before the current sprint section"` (tests/page.spec.js:17) asserts `#health p` has count 2, that nth(0) is "Status: All clear" and nth(1) is "Changed: Cycle time improved by 2 days" (proving intra-section order), then asserts `main > section` nth(0) has id "health" and nth(1) has id "current" (proving the health section precedes the Current Sprint section). This directly exercises the ordering and containment requirements.
